s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations
Multiple superficial ulcers with heaped-up margins
key_facts: CD4 count rose from 94 to 160 cells/mm3
Lip lesions developed 2 months after CD4 count improvement
Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus
Normal complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels
Negative Gram stain, acid-fast stain, and mucicarmine stain of lesion samples

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations
Multiple superficial ulcers with heaped-up margins
key_facts: CD4 count rose from 94 to 160 cells/mm3
Lip lesions developed 2 months after CD4 count improvement
Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus
Normal complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels
Negative Gram stain, acid-fast stain, and mucicarmine stain of lesion samples

shortlist.label: Cheilitis granulomatosa
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations, consistent with cheilitis granulomatosa

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with undetectable HIV viral load, but history of HIV-1 infection and potential exposure to histoplasmosis

shortlist.label: Mycobacterium avium complex infection
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with history of HIV-1 infection and potential exposure to mycobacterial infections

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with history of HIV-1 infection and potential for Kaposi's sarcoma

shortlist.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with history of HIV-1 infection and potential for lymphoproliferative disorders

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of lip swelling with painful ulcerations, lack of response to antibiotics and corticosteroids, and the development of lesions after CD4 count improvement are more consistent with cheilitis granulomatosa, especially given the negative tests for infectious causes.
raw.anchor_refutation: Histoplasmosis is refuted by the negative fungal blood cultures and both urine and serum Histoplasma antigen tests.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Negative fungal blood cultures and antigen tests

rejected.label: Mycobacterium avium complex infection
rejected.why: No evidence of mycobacterial infection in the provided key facts

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: The description of lip lesions does not match the typical presentation of Kaposi's sarcoma

rejected.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not support this diagnosis
